description: Track a product. Adds an ASIN, an Amazon link or a short link (amzn.to, a.co…) to your watchlist. The first check runs in the background within seconds (checking is true until then): poll GET /products/{id}, or send wait: true to get the answer once it's d…

interval_minutes.description: Minutes between two checks (1440 = daily). Checks faster than daily need a plan or a credit pack: every 60 minutes with a pack or Starter, 30 with Pro, 5 with Business. Default: 1440.

marketplace.description: Amazon store, e.g. com for amazon.com. A product link sets it on its own. Allowed values: com, co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, co.jp, com.br, com.mx, in. Default: "com".

target_price.description: Email the owner when the price goes at or below this amount. null removes it.

wait.description: Answer once the first check is done (up to 45 seconds) Default: false.

name: track_product
title: Track a product
